result.summary: Found 1 major visual/functionality issue where a card image is stuck in a loading state.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card's food image is stuck displaying a loading spinner instead of the fully loaded image content, leaving the card visually incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the image loading failure or slow load: ensure the image loads fully to show the actual food content, or replace the unresolved spinner with a static placeholder image or an error state if loading fails.
